title: Allison's Favorite
preamble: Colin suggests 32-bar jigs because of all the balancing
notes:
introduce diagonally across first.

For the partner swing, gentlespoons need to move forward and to the left as your partner approaches.

figures.text: gentlespoons make left hand star; balance the star
meet the one diagonally across from you; first corners balance & swing, finish on usual side facing into set
ladles make right hand star; balance the star
partners swing, face into the set
join hands in your ring of 8; balance the ring
partners California twirl to face a new line
